item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"Identifies the first recorded system prompt as the `self.react` prompt built from agent-style instructions that mention the task inputs/outputs, enumerate the available tools (plus `finish`), and require `next_thought`, `next_tool_name`, and `next_tool_args` outputs.","span_ids":["s1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"Identifies the second recorded system prompt as a separate extraction prompt because `ReAct` creates a `fallback_signature` with only the original signature's input/output fields and `signature.instructions`, then wraps it in `dspy.ChainOfThought` as `self.extract`.","span_ids":["s2"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"Shows an immediate-completion run where the first planning step selects `finish`, since `forward` breaks as soon as `next_tool_name == \"finish\"` and then calls `self.extract`, yielding one planning LM call followed by one extraction LM call.","span_ids":["s1","s3"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":20,"statement":"Checks the two printed system prompts accordingly: the first contains tool-planning markers such as the tool catalog and/or `next_tool_name`, while the second omits that catalog and planning fields and falls back to the original task-only instruction.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/predict/react.py","start_line":47,"end_line":79},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/predict/react.py","start_line":81,"end_line":88},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/predict/react.py","start_line":98,"end_line":118}]}
